title: Imu
description: Inertial sample, up to 100 Hz. Right-handed frame: in `device` frame +x is right, +y is up and +z points out of the screen (portrait). `mount` applies the `mount_offset` setting.

q.description: Orientation as unit quaternion [x, y, z, w], relative to a gravity-aligned reference frame.

accel.description: Specific force (gravity + user acceleration) in m/s^2.

sensor_time_s.description: Sensor timestamp in seconds since device boot, for precise intervals between samples.
